crossRefs.note: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

translations.web: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
translations.bsb: and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers had taken: 675,000 sheep,
translations.kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
translations.asv: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
